title: Prince Caspian
author: C. S. Lewis
summary: The four Pevensie children are pulled back to Narnia, where centuries have passed and the old creatures are hiding. They join a young prince who is fighting to take his rightful throne from his uncle.
readIf: you like gentle, classic fantasy where the magic arrives on the side of the underdog.
skipIf: you want fresh, surprising worlds; this is a return trip and leans on the first book.

pairings.reason: Another cosy adventure about brave talking animals who defend a place they love against a conqueror.
A comfortable older classic that mixes plain heroes with a sprawling magic quest.
A more philosophical, daring children's fantasy that treats Narnia's themes very differently.
